questions.question: Which element has the chemical symbol Hg?
questions.hint: It's the liquid metal in old thermometers
questions.note: Hg comes from the Greek "hydrargyrum", meaning liquid silver.

questions.question: Which organ in your body makes insulin?
questions.hint: It sits tucked behind your stomach
questions.note: It also makes juices that help you digest food.

questions.question: Gregor Mendel figured out the basics of genetics by experimenting on which plant?
questions.hint: They're green and come in pods
questions.note: He was a monk and grew almost 30,000 pea plants for his experiments.

questions.question: What's the softest mineral in the world?
questions.hint: It's what baby powder is made from
questions.note: It's a 1 on the hardness scale. Diamond is a 10.

questions.question: If you study entomology, what are you studying?
questions.note: Scientists think there are about 10 quintillion insects alive at any moment.

questions.question: Which ancient general famously marched war elephants over the Alps to attack Rome?
questions.hint: Same first name as a famous movie cannibal
questions.note: He did it in 218 BC. Most of the elephants didn't survive the war.

questions.question: What was the first sport ever played on the Moon?
questions.hint: It's played with clubs ⛳
questions.note: Astronaut Alan Shepard hit two golf balls there during Apollo 14 in 1971.

questions.question: The Great Fire of London in 1666 started in a bakery on which street?
questions.hint: It sounds like a dessert 🍮
questions.note: The fire burned for four days and destroyed most of the city.

questions.question: What was the nickname of WWI fighter pilot Manfred von Richthofen?
questions.hint: His plane was painted bright red
questions.note: He's also the pilot Snoopy is always battling in Peanuts.

questions.question: The 1400s civil wars between England's Houses of York and Lancaster are called the Wars of the… what?
questions.hint: It's a flower 🌹
questions.note: They were a big inspiration for Game of Thrones.

questions.question: What color is a polar bear's skin underneath its fur?
questions.hint: Probably the opposite of what you'd guess
questions.note: Their fur isn't really white either. It's see-through!

questions.question: What's the name for a group of bears?
questions.hint: It's also the name of a very slow animal 🦥
questions.note: A group of owls is called a parliament.

questions.question: Cashmere wool comes from which animal?
questions.hint: It has a little beard and loves to climb
questions.note: One goat only makes a few ounces of cashmere a year. That's why it's so pricey.

questions.question: What kind of animal is a natterjack?
questions.hint: It hops, and it's not a frog
questions.note: Its call can be heard from over a mile away.

questions.question: What's the largest species of penguin?
questions.hint: It has a royal-sounding name 👑
questions.note: They can grow almost 4 feet tall.

questions.question: In Cast Away, what does Tom Hanks name his volleyball?
questions.hint: It's named after the brand on the ball 🏐
questions.note: WILSONNN 😭

questions.question: "Nobody puts Baby in a corner" is a line from which movie?
questions.hint: Patrick Swayze, and a famous lift in a lake
questions.note: It came out in 1987 and people still try that lift at weddings.

questions.question: In Back to the Future, how fast does the DeLorean have to go to travel through time?
questions.hint: Somewhere between 80 and 90 mph
questions.note: Plus 1.21 gigawatts of electricity ⚡

questions.question: In Finding Nemo, what's the name of Nemo's mom?
questions.hint: It's something you'd find on a reef
questions.note: Only in the first two minutes, and it still hurts.

questions.question: Who voices Po in the Kung Fu Panda movies?
questions.hint: He's also the teacher in School of Rock
questions.note: He also voiced Bowser in The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

questions.question: What was the city of Istanbul called before it was Istanbul?
questions.hint: It was named after a Roman emperor, Constantine
questions.note: And before that, it was called Byzantium.

questions.question: Which country has three capital cities?
questions.hint: It's at the very bottom of a continent
questions.note: Pretoria, Cape Town, and Bloemfontein each do a different job.

questions.question: What's the capital of Turkey?
questions.hint: It's NOT the one from the first question 😉
questions.note: Istanbul is bigger, but Ankara has been the capital since 1923.

questions.question: Which country has the biggest Japanese population outside of Japan?
questions.hint: It's in South America and they speak Portuguese
questions.note: About 2 million Brazilians have Japanese roots.

questions.question: The ancient city of Petra, carved into pink rock cliffs, is in which country?
questions.hint: It's in the Middle East, and it's also a common first name
questions.note: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade filmed its ending there.

questions.question: Which DJ is famous for throwing cakes at fans during his sets?
questions.hint: His dad founded the Benihana restaurants 🍤
questions.note: you have nice cakes

questions.question: Which DJ performs in a giant glowing mouse head?
questions.hint: He's Canadian and spells his name with a 5
questions.note: His real name is Joel Zimmerman.

questions.question: What's the name of the giant EDM festival held every summer in Belgium?
questions.hint: It's named after a day that's always one away
questions.note: Around 400,000 people go every year, and tickets sell out almost instantly.

questions.question: Whose 2024 album "brat" started "brat summer"?
questions.hint: She was at ACL
questions.note: That lime green album cover was everywhere 💚

questions.question: Which Swedish DJ made "Addicted to You"?
questions.hint: He also made "Wake Me Up" and "Levels"
questions.note: your fav

questions.question: What fruit goes in a Black Forest cake?
questions.hint: They're red and come in pairs on a stem 🍒
questions.note: It's from Germany, and the real version has cherry brandy in it.

questions.question: What was Pepsi originally called?
questions.hint: It was named after its inventor, Caleb Bradham
questions.note: It got renamed to Pepsi-Cola in 1898.

questions.question: Which country grows most of the world's vanilla?
questions.hint: It's also the name of a movie about zoo animals
questions.note: Vanilla comes from an orchid, and every flower is pollinated by hand.

questions.question: What's Wallace and Gromit's favorite kind of cheese?
questions.hint: It's from Yorkshire and starts with W 🧀
questions.note: The films are credited with helping save the cheese's sales.

questions.question: Fugu, the risky Japanese delicacy, is made from which fish?
questions.hint: It blows up into a spiky ball when it's scared
questions.note: Chefs need years of training and a special license to serve it.

questions.question: What's the hottest planet in our solar system?
questions.hint: It's NOT the one closest to the Sun
questions.note: Its thick clouds trap heat, so it stays over 800°F, hotter than Mercury.

questions.question: About how many minutes does it take sunlight to reach Earth?
questions.hint: Less than 10
questions.note: So when you look at the Sun, you're seeing it as it was 8 minutes ago.

questions.question: The moons Miranda, Ariel, Titania, and Oberon orbit which planet?
questions.hint: It spins on its side
questions.note: Most of its moons are named after characters from Shakespeare.

questions.question: What were the first animals ever sent into space?
questions.hint: Tiny bugs that love old bananas 🍌
questions.note: They went up on a rocket in 1947 and came back alive.

questions.question: How many moons does Pluto have?
questions.hint: You can count them on one hand
questions.note: The biggest one, Charon, is about half the size of Pluto itself.

questions.question: Which TV show starred Blanche, Rose, Dorothy, and Sophia?
questions.hint: Four roommates in Miami who love cheesecake
questions.note: "Thank you for being a friend…" 🎶

questions.question: What fictional town is Parks and Recreation set in?
questions.hint: It's in Indiana
questions.note: Home of the one and only Li'l Sebastian 🐴

questions.question: In The Office, who does Michael Scott end up with?
questions.hint: Her name is also a Christmas plant
questions.note: They move to Colorado together. Peak romance.

questions.question: What's the name of the teenage witch who lives with her aunts Hilda and Zelda?
questions.hint: She has a talking black cat named Salem
questions.note: Melissa Joan Hart played her for 7 seasons.

questions.question: In which sitcom do two characters pitch NBC "a show about nothing"?
questions.hint: Jerry, George, Elaine, and Kramer
questions.note: Which is basically what Seinfeld itself was.

questions.question: In bowling, what do you call three strikes in a row?
questions.hint: Gobble gobble
questions.note: Twelve in a row is a perfect game: 300 points.

questions.question: In golf, what do you call finishing a hole two under par?
questions.hint: It's a bird, and bigger than a birdie
questions.note: Three under par is called an albatross!

questions.question: Which boxer bit off part of Evander Holyfield's ear in 1997?
questions.hint: Nicknamed "Iron Mike"
questions.note: They actually made up years later and became friends.

questions.question: Before LA, which city did the Dodgers play in?
questions.hint: It's one of New York City's boroughs
questions.note: The name comes from Brooklyn locals dodging trolley cars.

questions.question: Before LA, the Lakers played in which city?
questions.hint: Minnesota, the "Land of 10,000 Lakes"
questions.note: That's why LA has a team named after lakes.
